summary: On August 3, 2026, Lantheus Holdings entered into a merger agreement with Curium US Holdings (Parent) and Coco Merger Sub. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Lantheus, with Lantheus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Each share of Lantheus common stock will be converted into $102.50 cash plus one contingent value right (CVR) worth up to $12.00 upon commercial milestones, implying total consideration of up to $114.50 per share. The transaction is a going-private acquisition; shareholders may exercise appraisal rights under Delaware law. Advisors and board recommendation are not specified. Watch for stockholder vote, regulatory clearances, and CVR milestone achievement.
